description: This Python script analyzes Android blueprint files, specifically parsing and classifying modules such as libraries and interfaces, to verify dependencies and manage module categorization within the Android build system.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Blueprint module with methods to access properties and dependencies.

classes.name: ModuleClassifier
classes.description: Manages collections of modules categorized by their types, such as VNDK, vendor, or llndk.

methods.name: get_property
methods.description: Retrieves a nested property value from the module's attributes.

methods.name: is_vndk
methods.description: Checks if the module is a VNDK shared library.

methods.name: is_vndk_sp
methods.description: Checks if the module is a VNDK-SP shared library.

methods.name: is_vendor
methods.description: Checks if the module is a vendor module.

methods.name: is_vendor_available
methods.description: Checks if the module is vendor available.

methods.name: has_vendor_variant
methods.description: Checks if the module is either VNDK or vendor available.

methods.name: get_dependencies
methods.description: Returns sorted lists of shared, static, and header library dependencies.

methods.name: add_module
methods.description: Adds a module to internal dictionaries based on its type.

methods.name: _add_modules_from_parsed_pairs
methods.description: Processes parsed module data and adds modules accordingly.

methods.name: parse_root_bp
methods.description: Parses a root blueprint file and populates module data.

methods.name: create_from_root_bp
methods.description: Creates a ModuleClassifier instance from a root blueprint file.
